[![Epoch AI](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!ZsOK!,w_40,h_40,c_fill,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fca617831-3128-496f-8aac-33d1fadda48f_176x176.png)](https://epochai.substack.com/) # [Epoch AI](https://epochai.substack.com/) SubscribeSign in [Data Insights](https://epochai.substack.com/s/data-insights/?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=menu) # Google controls the most AI computing power, driven by its custom TPUs [Luke Emberson](https://substack.com/@lemberson), [Venkat Somala](https://substack.com/@vssomala), and [Josh You](https://substack.com/@joshyou) Apr 07, 2026 19 2 Share Who owns the world’s compute? Our new [Chip Ownership hub](https://epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-owners/) shows that Google leads, holding around 25% of all compute sold since 2022. [![Image](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!hMU6!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F6245e863-cc2f-48d5-beca-160f8ca40256_1026x1283.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!hMU6!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F6245e863-cc2f-48d5-beca-160f8ca40256_1026x1283.png) Google stands out for another reason: around three quarters of their compute is provided by their in-house designed TPU chips. All other hyperscalers rely predominantly on Nvidia’s GPUs.
